title: StandX announces DUSD minting restriction and final redemption window
description: StandX announced its phased closure; contemporaneous reports state DUSD minting and new registration would close October 20, 2026, and redemption requests and platform withdrawals would close January 31, 2027. The 2027 deadline is future-dated and is not evidence that redemption has already ended.
notes: No verified proof of completed redemptions, reserves or final shutdown. Do not set discontinued_date before actual cessation is evidenced.
